headlines.title: Nvidia Board Launches Probe In CEO Jensen Huang Spying Case. The Stock Is Falling.
headlines.summary: The Nvidia board has launched an independent probe in the wake of reporting that CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign espionage plot.

headlines.title: Buy, Sell, or Hold? Monday’s Top Upgrades and Downgrades: Advanced Micro Devices, Airbnb, DraftKings, L3 Harris Technologies, Molson-Coors, Nvidia,  Take-Two Interactive, Uber Technologies, and More
headlines.summary: Nvidia just lost a vote of confidence while AMD earned a $600 target, and Wall Street's chip debate is splitting wide open. Add a Fed rate hike looming and a flurry of fresh Citigroup calls, and Monday's analyst moves get interesting.

headlines.title: Nvidia braces for $200bn hit over ‘Chinese spy’ affair
headlines.summary: The boss of Nvidia is fighting to keep his job after he admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Google Escalates Nvidia Rivalry With Specialized Versions of AI Chips
headlines.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google is rolling out a broader array of artificial intelligence chips, aiming to capitalize on its rapid ascent as a challenger to Nvidia Corp. in a market worth hundreds of billions of dollars.

headlines.title: Only One Analyst Rates Nvidia a Sell. Is the Lone Bear Onto Something?
headlines.summary: Wall Street has almost entirely agreed on Nvidia, yet institutional filers are quietly splitting and a CEO probe is rattling the board. The case against the stock rests on financing exposure, thinning margins, and one number worth watching.

description: NVIDIA Corporation operates as a data center scale AI infrastructure company in the United States, Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Compute & Networking, and Graphics segments. The Compute & Networking segment provides data center accelerated computing and networking platforms and artificial intelligence solutions and software, and automotive platforms and autonomous and electric vehicle solutions, including software. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs; Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics. The company's products are used in gaming, professional visualization, data center, and automotive markets. It sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, original device manufacturers, system integrators and distributors, independent software vendors, cloud service providers, add-in board manufacturers, distributors, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, and other ecosystem participants. It has a collaboration with Cisco to develop Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a high-density optical module pluggable transceiver. It has a collaboration with ChipAgents to develop Build-A-Chip-Bench, a benchmark for AI agents carrying chip design tasks and The Company has a strategic alliance with MediaTek to build the next generations of AI computing platforms. NVIDIA Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
